# Spec: 009-ci-docs-only
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-10-23 -->
<!-- Source: board item FAB-3 (tasks/TODO.md) -->

## Overview

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs every job on every pull request, so a pull request that changes
nothing but documentation waits on `Tests`, the isolation harness, `Build` and the two
Lighthouse jobs (up to 45 minutes each). This feature lets a **docs-only** pull request finish
the code-stage jobs green without running their work, while every job keeps its name — the job
names are the required status checks on `dev` and `main` (`ci.yml` header,
`.github/required-checks.json`) — and a pull request that touches anything else runs the full
set exactly as today.

## Context the requirements rest on (measured in this tree)

- **Required contexts are job names.** `.github/required-checks.json` records 16 contexts per
  branch, including four of the six `Isolation harness can fail (<layer>)` matrix legs. A
  `paths-ignore` skips the whole workflow, so no context reports and the pull request stays
  blocked.
- **A job-level `if:` cannot gate the matrix job.** GitHub evaluates a job-level `if:` before it
  expands the matrix, so a skipped `isolation-mutation` reports one check named literally
  `Isolation harness can fail (${{ matrix.layer }})` — and the per-layer contexts protection
  requires never appear. The matrix job must expand and report each leg.
- **A skipped dependency is a silent green.** If a gated job `needs:` a detector and the
  detector fails, GitHub skips the dependent job, and a skipped required check counts as
  passing. A detector failure must therefore never be able to turn into skipped gates.
- **The test suite reads Markdown.** `pnpm test` (the `Tests` job) reads, among others,
  `docs/tech-stack.md`, `docs/avatar-budget.md`, `docs/lcp-measurements.md`, `docs/lgpd.md`,
  `docs/backlog.md`, `docs/content-model.md`,
  `.specify/specs/003-paginas-publicas/tasks.md` and `.specify/specs/004-contas-avatar/{spec,tasks}.md`
  (`apps/web/tests/**`; the full, larger list is in research.md). An edit to one of those files
  can turn `Tests` red, so it is not "docs only" for the purpose of skipping `Tests`. And
  `packages/ui/tests/fonts.test.ts` scans **every** tracked file outside `.specify/` via
  `git ls-files`, so every other Markdown file is an input of `Tests` too.
- **The workflow is itself pinned by tests.** `apps/web/tests/required-checks.test.ts` and
  `scripts/required-checks.sh` treat every 4-space-indented `name:` in `ci.yml` as a CI gate and
  require each to be either a required context or a documented gap in
  `.specify/specs/003-paginas-publicas/tasks.md`; `apps/web/tests/lcp-ci-jobs.test.ts` pins the
  two performance jobs' names, scripts, Postgres service and the absence of any test-suite
  invocation (its `RUNS_THE_SUITE` regex matches the bare word `vitest` anywhere in those job
  bodies); `apps/web/tests/isolation-mutation-layers.test.ts` reads the `layer:` matrix.

## Definitions

- **Docs-only change**: a pull request whose changed files (base branch → pull-request head) are
  all Markdown (`*.md`, any directory), **and** none of which is a Markdown file the repository's
  tests or CI scripts read. Anything else — including `.mdx`, `ci.yml`, `.github/**`, lockfiles,
  images and JSON — is a **code change**.
- **Docs-stage jobs**: `Secret scan`, `Markdown lint`, `Link integrity`. They always run.
- **Code-stage jobs**: every other job in `ci.yml` — `Lint`, `Colour tokens`, `Type check`,
  `Tests`, `Cross-tenant isolation`, `Isolation harness can fail (<layer>)` × every matrix
  layer, `Migration drift`, `Performance budget`, `Performance budget can fail`, `Build`.

## User Scenarios

### US1: A docs-only pull request is mergeable in minutes [P1]
- **Given** a pull request into `dev` that changes only `README.md` and `docs/roadmap-notes.md`
  (neither read by any test)
- **When** CI runs
- **Then** every one of the 16 required contexts in `.github/required-checks.json` reports
  success, the docs-stage jobs run their real checks, no code-stage job migrates, builds, mutates
  or runs Lighthouse, and `Tests` runs only the tests that read the whole tree (FR-014)
- **Edge**: a docs-only pull request that edits a `plan.md`, `research.md` or checklist under
  `.specify/specs/` that no test reads → still docs-only. Any `spec.md` or `tasks.md` under
  `.specify/specs/*` is code, by construction: tests read those basenames as quoted `join()`
  segments, and the classifier does not resolve which feature directory a segment belongs to
- **Error**: a docs-only pull request with a broken relative link → `Link integrity` goes red
  and blocks, exactly as today

### US2: A pull request that touches code runs the full set [P1]
- **Given** a pull request that changes `apps/web/lib/foo.ts` and `docs/foo.md`
- **When** CI runs
- **Then** every code-stage job runs its full steps, as it does before this feature
- **Edge**: a pull request that changes only `.github/workflows/ci.yml` → full set
- **Edge**: a pull request that changes only a `.mdx` file → full set
- **Error / negative**: the pull request must NOT have any code-stage job skipped or shortened

### US3: Markdown the tests read is treated as code [P1]
- **Given** a pull request that changes only `docs/lgpd.md` (read by
  `apps/web/tests/accounts/lgpd-doc.test.ts`)
- **When** CI runs
- **Then** it is classified as a code change and `Tests` runs in full
- **Edge**: the same for `.specify/specs/003-paginas-publicas/tasks.md`
- **Negative**: a Markdown file referenced by a test must NOT be classified as docs

### US4: Detection fails safe [P1]
- **Given** a pull request where the change classification cannot be computed (detector step
  errors, base commit unavailable, empty or unreadable changed-file list)
- **When** CI runs
- **Then** every code-stage job runs its full steps
- **Negative**: a classification failure must NOT produce a skipped or green-without-running
  code-stage job

### US5: Pushes to protected branches are unaffected [P1]
- **Given** a push to `dev` or `main` (including a merge of a docs-only pull request)
- **When** CI runs
- **Then** every job runs its full steps — the post-merge run is the backstop that measures the
  merged tree

### US6: The gate wiring is pinned by a test [P2]
- **Given** the repository test suite
- **When** a future edit removes the docs-only gate from a code-stage job, applies it to a
  docs-stage job, gates the matrix job at job level, or renames a job
- **Then** `pnpm test` fails with a message naming the job and the rule broken

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | CI classifies each `pull_request` run as docs-only or code from the full list of files changed between the pull request's base and head. | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-002 | A run is docs-only iff every changed path ends in `.md` and no changed path is quoted — as its full repo-relative path or as its basename — in a tracked non-Markdown file other than the classifier's own test (`apps/web/tests/ci-change-scope.test.ts`, whose fixtures quote docs paths on purpose); every other run is code. | P1 | US1, US2, US3 |
| FR-003 | On a docs-only run every code-stage job still starts and reports its unchanged job name with a success conclusion, and performs none of its work (no migration, build, mutation or Lighthouse run; no dependency install except where FR-014 needs it). | P1 | US1 |
| FR-004 | The matrix job `isolation-mutation` reports one success context per layer on a docs-only run (`Isolation harness can fail (<layer>)`), i.e. it is never skipped at job level. | P1 | US1 |
| FR-005 | Docs-stage jobs (`Secret scan`, `Markdown lint`, `Link integrity`) run their full checks on every run, docs-only or not. | P1 | US1 |
| FR-006 | On a code run every code-stage job executes exactly the steps it executes before this feature. | P1 | US2 |
| FR-007 | Any failure, error or missing output in classification results in the code path (full run); no code-stage job may be skipped or succeed without running because classification failed. | P1 | US4 |
| FR-008 | `push` events (to `dev`/`main`) always take the code path. | P1 | US5 |
| FR-009 | No job is renamed, no required context is removed or added in `.github/required-checks.json`, and the `layer:` matrix is unchanged. | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-010 | The change adds no third-party GitHub Action; classification uses `git` and shell already available on the runner. | P2 | US1 |
| FR-011 | `pnpm test` stays green without weakening any assertion in `required-checks.test.ts`, `lcp-ci-jobs.test.ts` or `isolation-mutation-layers.test.ts`. | P1 | US6 |
| FR-012 | The classifier is a script under `scripts/` with a documented exit/output contract, exercised by a test with docs-only, code, test-read-Markdown and failure inputs. | P2 | US3, US4, US6 |
| FR-013 | A test pins the wiring: every code-stage job is gated by the classification, no docs-stage job is, and the matrix job is gated per step rather than at job level. | P2 | US6 |
| FR-014 | On a docs-only run, `Tests` still runs every test that reads the whole tracked tree (today `packages/ui/tests/fonts.test.ts`, which scans every tracked Markdown file outside `.specify/`), without a database; a test asserts that every test file making an unscoped `git ls-files` call is in that set, and that every pathspec-scoped caller lists only directories holding no tracked `.md`. | P1 | US1, US3 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | A docs-only pull request into `dev` shows all 16 required contexts green within 5 minutes of the run starting. | After merge, open a probe pull request changing only an untested `.md`; read the checks list and run timings (`gh pr checks`). |
| SC-002 | A code pull request runs every code-stage job's full step list. | The implementing pull request itself (it changes `ci.yml`): each job log shows install/test/build steps executed, not skipped. |
| SC-003 | Changing only a test-read Markdown file runs `Tests` in full. | Classifier test case with `docs/lgpd.md`; optionally a probe pull request. |
| SC-004 | A forced classifier failure yields a full run. | Classifier test case with an unreadable/empty input and a non-zero exit, asserting the code verdict; wiring test asserts consumers treat a missing output as code. |
| SC-005 | `pnpm test` passes, with the new wiring and classifier tests included. | `pnpm test` locally and the `Tests` job on the implementing pull request. |
| SC-006 | No required context changes. | `.github/required-checks.json` unchanged in the diff; `required-checks.test.ts` green. |

## Constitution check

Principle 5 requires the gates to be merge-blocking on every pull request and the gate set never
to shrink. No gate is removed and no context changes (FR-009). The tests' Markdown inputs come in two kinds,
and each is covered: files read by **literal path** make the pull request code (FR-002, US3), and
the tests that read the **whole tree** still run on a docs-only pull request (FR-014). The
residual is a test that builds a Markdown path from variables or walks a directory without
`git ls-files` — none exists today (research.md); the FR-014 pin catches the `ls-files` form, and
the post-merge `push` run re-measures the merged tree in full (FR-008) as the backstop for the
rest.

## Decisions taken without clarification

- **Docs = `*.md` only.** Not `docs/**` wholesale: `docs/` may hold non-Markdown assets, and the
  narrower rule only errs toward running more. `.mdx` is code (Next.js compiles it).
- **All code-stage jobs are gated**, not only the five the board item names: `Lint`,
  `Type check`, `Colour tokens` and `Migration drift` have no Markdown input either, and gating
  them uniformly keeps the wiring test a single rule.
- **"Read by tests" is detected conservatively.** The classifier may over-match (treat an
  untested `.md` as code) but must never under-match a literal read; quoting is required so that
  prose mentions (`README.md` in a code comment) do not count.
- **Whether the detector is a separate job or a step inside each job is a plan decision.** The
  board item proposes a first job; a separate job adds a 4-space `name:` that the required-checks
  pin counts as a gate, which the plan must reconcile without weakening that pin.
- **No git branch was created**: this item is planned on its worktree branch `worktree-FAB-3`.
